bounded_overlay.description: Uncommitted datasets-owned P1-P5 compositional contract, abstract interpretation, assume-guarantee, incremental invalidation, incremental SMT and interpolation adapters, focused tests, and additive verification API edits. These files are candidate implementation evidence, not an accepted revision or production authority.

authority_boundary.datasets: Semantic meaning, canonical logic artifacts, contracts, abstract state, proof obligations, semantic state and capsules, translation/prover evidence and confidence classes.
authority_boundary.accelerator: Operational planning, routing, leases, fences, isolated mutation, task/objective state, model invocation, benchmarking, rollback and operational DuckDB records.

plan_truth.interpretation: Task implementation is complete in the durable live board, but objective completion, release qualification beyond research_demo, and production authorization do not follow. Historical boards and accepted or quarantined evidence remain immutable.
